notes.title: MIGHTREYA New Playtest is Live! ⚡
notes.notes:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120208/f2e7fd37b2f9a6b2cd5a2ed15914c89cf5ea190f.png"][/img]

Hello Heroes,[/p][p]
Following your feedback from the first [b]playtest[/b], we’ve decided to open a second one [b]starting today[/b], with some improvements and a few of your suggestions implemented.
[/p][p]This new playtest will be available for approximately [b]two weeks[/b], and we hope you’ll once again step into Reya’s shoes to help Wazen – the sole dev working on MIGHTREYA – shape it into the best version possible.⚡ 
[/p][p]As always, please remember that this is an [b]early version of the game[/b] – a work-in-progress build where many things are still being polished, adjusted, or reworked. Because of this, you may encounter visual glitches, gameplay hiccups, balance issues, placeholders, and performance dips.
[/p][p]We hope you’ll share your experience, feedback, and suggestions with us – both here on the forum and, most importantly, in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/qQ9cYQvbDG"][u][b]MIGHTREYA Official Discord[/b][/u][/url]! 
[/p][p]This is your chance to be part of MIGHTREYA’s development journey. Dive in, explore, break things, and share your thoughts with us!
[/p][p][b]Happy testing[/b] 🔥
[/p]

notes.title: Playtest Closure
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120208/15de89d9b842936cf8ca921019ffebe456db8559.png"][/img]

Hello heroes,
[/p][p]We’d like to inform you that the [b]MIGHTREYA[/b] playtest is coming to an end — you’ll have time to play until [b]Friday, July 11 at 10:00 AM CEST / 5:00 PM JST / 1:00 AM PDT / 4:00 AM EDT[/b]. Make sure to jump in and share your feedback before the deadline![/p][p]
We also want to thank you for the incredible support: over [b]10,000 aspiring superheroes[/b] wanted to step into Reya’s shoes over the past few days, sharing their experiences, feedback, and valuable suggestions with us.[/p][p]
We invite you to join our [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/qQ9cYQvbDG"]official Discord[/url][/b] to keep connecting with our passionate community and be the first to know when the next opportunity to try the game before launch arises.[/p][p]
See you soon, heroes![/p]

notes.title: Join MIGHTREYA Playtest! ⚡
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120208/f2e7fd37b2f9a6b2cd5a2ed15914c89cf5ea190f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello heroes, [/p][p]Get ready to experience Reya’s power firsthand, because we’re about to launch a playtest! ⚡ [/p][p][/p][p]Starting from [b]Friday, June 27 @ 10am CEST / 5pm JST / 1am PDT / 4am EDT[/b], a MIGHTREYA playtest will be available to those who, beginning today, have registered their interest by clicking the green [b]"Request Access"[/b] button on the game’s Steam page. [/p][p][/p][p]From that moment on, we hope you’ll share your experience, feedback, and suggestions with us - both here on the forum and, most importantly, in the new[url="https://discord.com/invite/qQ9cYQvbDG"] [b][u]MIGHTREYA Official Discord[/u][/b][/url]! 
 [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3077640/MIGHTREYA/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120208/42f01877bce5094c8459280520a66ecff471f090.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The purpose of this test is to gather your invaluable [b]feedback[/b], and we want to make sure you know exactly what to expect. [/p][p]This will be an [b]early version[/b] of the game - think of it as a work-in-progress build where many things are still being polished, adjusted, or even completely reworked. As with any beta test, you might encounter: [/p][list][*][p][b]Visual glitches[/b] (e.g., textures popping in, animations not playing smoothly). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Gameplay hiccups[/b] (e.g., quest triggers not firing, abilities behaving unexpectedly). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Balance issues[/b] (e.g., enemies being too tough/too easy, loot drops feeling off). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Placeholder or missing content[/b] (some UI elements, sounds, music, animations or even entire mechanics may change in the final version). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Performance dips[/b] (frame rate spikes, longer loading times in certain areas). [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Why does this matter?[/b] Because your reports help us squash bugs, refine mechanics, and make Mightreya the best experience it can be! If something feels odd, broken, or just [i]not fun[/i], [b]please let us know - [/b]your input directly shapes the final game. 
 
This is your chance to be part of MIGHTREYA’s development journey. Dive in, explore, break things, and share your thoughts with us! 
 
[b]Happy testing [/b]🔥 [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The MIX Showcase & NYX Game Awards
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120208/15de89d9b842936cf8ca921019ffebe456db8559.png[/img]

Hey aspiring superheroes, 
 
Exciting news from the world of MIGHTREYA! 

Last week, we celebrated a big win at the NYX Game Awards, where we took home four awards in the categories [b]Best Character Design[/b],[b] Indie Game[/b], [b]Action Game[/b] and [b]Fighting Game[/b]! 🔥 
 
[previewyoutube=k_uDXaB72Vk;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re thrilled that the work of Wazen – the solo dev behind MIGHTREYA – has been recognized by a panel of game developers, creatives, and game-related professionals worldwide. We can’t wait for you to experience the spectacular battles that bring this world to life. 

In the meantime, we invite you to join us during [b]The MIX Fall Showcase on November 21st @ 9 AM PST[/b] for an exclusive look at the epic aerial fights ready to challenge you in MIGHTREYA ⚡ 

Don’t miss it – and come cheer for Reya! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120208/5b2ac729d4253cb7de69b156e386791264b2425b.png[/img]

notes.title: MIGHTREYA x 505 Games!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120208/15de89d9b842936cf8ca921019ffebe456db8559.png[/img]

Hey aspiring superheroes, 

We are excited to announce that the solo Japanese indie developer [b]Wazen[/b] will be partnering with [b]505 Games[/b] to publish [b]MIGHTREYA[/b] worldwide! 
 
To celebrate, we’ve worked together on a new trailer to give you a first look at the spectacular aerial battles that await you 💥 
 
[previewyoutube=Oc6QHyZgqIk;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[i]MIGHTREYA[/i] is an anime-styled hero action game, [b]set to launch in 2025[/b]. Players will step into the shoes of the unexpected hero Reya and her manager Nio as they navigate their roles as Hero Content Creators in a world suddenly besieged by monstrous beings from another dimension.  

Prepare for heart-pounding superhero aerial battles with intuitive controls, allowing players to effortlessly lock onto targets, unleash rapid attacks, and chain combos with ease. 
 
We can't wait to see you in action, but in the meantime, be sure to follow [url=https://x.com/WZN__K]Wazen's official channel on X[/url] for your weekly dose of updates on MIGHTREYA's development! 

Ready to fight 💪
